info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Orbit API
Returns the daily files from Open:FactSet Partner - Orbit.

params.name: _sort
params.description: Enables to get the data in ascending or descending order based on startTime. Results are in reverse chronological order if this parameter is not used.

params.name: _paginationLimit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of results to return per result.

params.name: _paginationOffset
params.description: Specifies the starting point for pagination. This parameter is used to identify the beginning of next set of results. Using this parameter can fetch maximum of first 10000 records.

params.name: startDate
params.description: The earliest date of the Orbit file the API should fetching for based on fileTimestamp.

params.name: endDate
params.description: The latest date of the Orbit file the API should fetching for based on fileTimestamp.

params.name: stockCode
params.description: The company/ticker which is associated with the transcript. Please submit a question via Issue Tracker under the Open:FactSet - Partner Communication to get the required list of tickers.

params.name: fileName
params.description: This parameter is used to filters the results based on file name.

params.name: title
params.value: 投资者关系活动记录表2022-001
params.description: This parameter is used to filter the results based on the headline of the transcript.
